|lore=Infamous '''bounty hunter'''. Hired to help Jabba intimidate debtors and smugglers. Crack shot. Mandalorian armor and jet pack provide protection and flight capability.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power and 1 to maneuver of any starship he pilots. May deploy -1 as a 'react' to same site as a gangster or smuggler. When firing weapons, any 'hit' characters are forfeit = 0. May 'fly' (landspeed = 3). Immune to attrition &lt; 3.

|notes=This white-border card was first released in the [[First Anthology]] box (May 1997), as one of its six preview cards of the coming [[Special Edition]] expansion; it is the first printing of the card. Special Edition itself, with the black-border [[Boba Fett (Special Edition)]], followed in November 1998.<ref name="enc26">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=26 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia Rev. 3.2], page 26.
